Near the 650 Metres was steadied when crowded between RUN RUN SUNRISE and MASTER LUCKY which was taken out by JOY STAR when that horse lay out despite the efforts of its rider.  M Chadwick reported that after being crowded for room near the 650 Metres his mount did not finish the race off thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 600 Metres was steadied to avoid JUMBO BLESSING (H Bowman) which shifted out when racing greenly.  H Bowman was advised to ensure that he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.  Near the 450 Metres L Ferraris was obliged to reposition his foot in his left stirrup.  L Ferraris reported that his mount made a respiratory noise during the running of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

On jumping made contact with TAI VICTORY due to both runners shifting ground.  When questioned H Bowman stated that he was given no specific instructions.  He said when JUMBO BLESSING jumped reasonably well he elected to go forward and cross towards the outside rail.  He said as he commenced to shift out JUMBO BLESSING raced greenly and hung out and as a result did not show sufficient pace to clear LEADING DRAGON.  He added over the concluding stages JUMBO BLESSING weakened and did not respond to his riding.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race revealed that the horse was displaying an irregular heart rhythm.  Before being allowed to race again, JUMBO BLESSING will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Jumped only fairly.  L Hewitson could offer no explanation for his horse’s failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
On jumping made contact with JUMBO BLESSING due to both runners shifting ground.  Noted to have lost its left front plate after the race.

When SMART TRIO then shifted out slightly FAMILY FORTUNE was checked when disappointed for clear running between ON THE LASH and SMART TRIO. Jumped only fairly and then was bumped by KING PROFIT which shifted in. Approaching the 600 Metres shifted in and made contact with ALABAMA SONG when being steadied to avoid NEXT FORTUNE. Near the 100 Metres was bumped heavily by NEXT FORTUNE.

B Avdulla stated that from a wide barrier he was obliged to settle back in the field.  He added in the Home Straight he was satisfied with the horse’s finishing effort as it continued to make ground under pressure.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 100 Metres ALABAMA SONG (A Atzeni) was shifted to the outside of KING PROFIT to improve, resulting in WORLD HERO being taken out onto QUARTZ LEGEND which then shifted out and away from WORLD HERO, resulting in NEXT FORTUNE making heavy contact with GET FRIENDLY.  A Atzeni was advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.
Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Over the concluding stages was hampered when NEXT FORTUNE shifted in.  Noted to have blood in its mouth after the race.
For some distance near the 1000 Metres raced keenly when being steadied away from QUARTZ LEGEND.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  Raced keenly when obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Bumped approaching the winning post.

Fractious in the starting gates, jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Near the 900 Metres, when racing keenly, improved to the inside of QUARTZ LEGEND as QUARTZ LEGEND improved to the inside of ALABAMA SONG.  A short distance later when the pace of the event steadied ALABAMA SONG then shifted in slightly and it was then unable to relieve the crowding to its inside when racing tight to the inside of GET FRIENDLY.  The Stewards found the racing manners of TOP MAESTRO was the significant contributor to the interference.  TOP MAESTRO continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages and near the 700 Metres was steadied away from QUARTZ LEGEND.  Again near the 550 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from QUARTZ LEGEND.

He said as a result TOP PEAK was left without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

C Y Ho could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer W Y So stated the horse had pleased him leading into the race but could offer no excuse for the performance.  He added having regard to today’s disappointing performance he would spell MABUBU.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of MABUBU was considered disappointing as compared to its previous race starts.  Before being allowed to race again, MABUBU will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
No report.

When questioned H Bowman stated that whilst he had expected to settle back in the field he did not intend to be as far back as what he was in the early stages.  He said after shifting his mount behind runners in the early stages he was satisfied with the horse settling back in the field where it was positioned as TURIN CHAMPIONS was racing comfortably.  He said as he felt the pace was genuine in the early stages he did not push TURIN CHAMPIONS along as he had expected the field to come back to him on the Home Turn and his mount was racing in a comfortable rhythm.  He added when asked for an effort from the 600 Metres TURIN CHAMPIONS lay in and as it was carrying the top weight of 135 lbs and being an inexperienced 3 year old he elected to make ground on the inside, particularly as he felt it was advantageous to do so given today’s track pattern.  He said after improving on the Home Turn he followed BIG RETURN into the race from the 400 Metres but had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 400 Metres and the 200 Metres.  He said after improving to the outside of BIG RETURN approaching the 100 Metres he then became badly held up over the concluding stages behind BRIGHT DAY and as a consequence TURIN CHAMPIONS went to the finish of the race without being tested.  Trainer D A Hayes stated that whilst he expected the horse to settle back in the field his preference would have been for the horse to make a run wider on the track.  He added after Jockey Bowman explained the reasons why he elected to go to the inside he accepted his explanation.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Bowman were reasonable in the circumstances.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

When questioned regarding his riding from the 600 Metres M Guyon stated that after following one of the favoured runners BEAUTY ALLIANCE he was satisfied to follow that horse into the race as he felt it would provide his mount with the opportunity to improve with cover.  He said when LOVERO improved to his outside near the 600 Metres he was reluctant to shift out as, in his opinion, THE RED HARE does not run out a strong 1600 Metres and he felt it would be too early to make a move from that stage.  He added after being held up between the 400 Metres and the 250 Metres when being shifted to the outside of LOVERO he was able to improve with the winner POWER OF VITAM but that runner finished stronger over the concluding stages although his mount continued to run on well.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Guyon were reasonable in the circumstances.  Sent for sampling post-race.
